expected_response.note: No registered bounded edit is tied to the cited diagnostic observable; incumbent retained.

failure_modes: Editing pointcloud_delta_A would change endpoint-distance curvature, not the short pair-kernel density the Analyst cites, so the predicted response would not test the stated hypothesis.
A region_index edit toward a global-centroid-dominated landmark would act on a coordinate with no adjusted support (branch_adjusted:0-2, 77-79, 231-233).
A temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend edit would rely on unvalidated interpolations with sign conflicts and no accepted polynomial (continuous:0-9, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90).
A teacher_neighbors edit would treat neighbor count as a distance bandwidth, which the supplied evidence does not establish.
Treating joint-head survival enrichment or turnover residual as terminal affinity benefit would misstate the semantics of the supplied tables.
rationale: Retain the incumbent coordinate program. The Analyst's strongest endpoint evidence (short pair-kernel density, pair_kernel_1.5/2.5/3.5 and landmark_00_occupancy3, endpoint_effects:9-11,15) is a diagnostic contrast on the endpoint pointcloud, not a term the executing pointcloud scalar contains; the formula registry states the executing scalar has no pair-kernel, moment, joint-motif or geometry-block term, so no registered bounded edit (pointcloud_delta_A, region_index, teacher_neighbors, temporal_region_index, temporal_teacher_blend) can be tied to that observable without inventing a mechanism the formula does not contain. The permitted pointcloud_delta_A edit changes the robust curvature of the Hungarian endpoint distance, not short pair-kernel density, so it is not an operative expression of the Analyst's hypothesis. Global centroid coordinates carry no adjusted support (branch_adjusted:0-2, 77-79, 231-233, q>=0.62), so a region_index edit toward a centroid-dominated landmark is not defensible. Continuous contrast functions are observed-node linear interpolations with polynomial_accepted=false, no extrapolation, many sign changes and strong sign conflicts (continuous:0-9, 10, 20, 30, 40, 50, 60, 70, 80, 90), so a temporal_region_index or temporal_teacher_blend edit is not supported by validated fits. Teacher neighborhood width is not established by neighbor count, and teacher_modes reports 28 teachers with assignment RMS quantiles [0.446, 0.863, 1.050], so a teacher_neighbors edit is not justified. Descendant credit is recorded joint-head credit, not decoded terminal affinity (decoded_terminal_learning_labels_available=false; lineage_support), and turnover residuals are accounting diagnostics (turnover:1,2,14,17,47,134,224,227), so neither supports an operative coordinate edit. Temperatures are immutable and no temperature edit is proposed. Retaining the incumbent is the defensible choice under the affinity-first objective; the evidence that would change this decision is a registered recipe whose executing scalar contains the cited observable, or validated time-conditioned fits meeting the curve_support fidelity rule, neither of which is supplied.
